# The Digital Pantry

> Women-led Cape Town web studio run by co-founders Aaniquah Dicks (software engineer) and Imaan Cooper (creative director). Builds custom websites from scratch (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, hosted on Netlify) for South African small businesses. Packages from R600 to R2 500 once-off.

Brand line: "Coded in Pink. Built to Perform." Based in Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa. Works with small businesses across South Africa.

## Key facts
- Services: custom small business websites, WhatsApp ordering buttons, custom domain and Google Business setup, basic SEO, lead capture automation (Pro).
- Prices (ZAR, once-off, for South African small businesses with up to 10 staff): Starter R600, Standard R1 000, Premium R1 600, Pro R2 500. Optional retainer R120/month for small edits. Larger businesses: custom quote from R8 000. International clients: USD packages, Starter $450, Standard $750, Premium $1 200, Pro $1 800, retainer $90/month.
- Turnaround: Starter, Standard and Premium sites take 5 to 7 business days, counted from when the deposit is paid and all content is in. Feedback within 2 business days keeps the date; slower feedback moves it by the same amount. Domain registrar waits are not counted. Pro, e-commerce and custom builds get an estimate in the quote.
- No coding knowledge needed from the client.
- Free mock-up: one free concept per business, for qualified enquiries (a real business, with the decision-maker, open to a paid build). A mock-up pack (phone and desktop videos and a quote PDF), not a working site, within 5 business days of the brief. Development, a live link, source files and revisions start once the deposit is paid; the concept and files stay ours until the agreed fee is paid. No obligation to go ahead. Ask on the contact page.
- Contact: email thedigitalpantryza@gmail.com (the best way to reach us), or the enquiry form at https://digitalpantry.co.za/contact.

- [Contact](https://digitalpantry.co.za/contact): email and enquiry form (ask for a quote or a free mock-up)
- [Privacy notice](https://digitalpantry.co.za/privacy): POPIA privacy notice
- [Websites for food businesses](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-food-businesses): menus, pop-up spots and WhatsApp ordering for Cape Town bakeries, pop-ups and takeaways
- [Websites for schools and madrasahs](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-schools-and-madrasahs): programmes, registration and FAQs for schools, madrasahs and learning centres
- [Websites for beauty businesses](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-beauty-businesses): services and prices, a gallery of your work and one way to book, for salons, lash and nail techs
- [Websites for consultants and professional services](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-consultants): clear services, trust signals and better enquiries for coaches, bookkeepers and consultants
- [Websites for product brands](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-product-brands): catalogue, brand story and a clear way to buy, from WhatsApp orders to an online shop (quoted separately)
- [Websites for trades and local services](https://digitalpantry.co.za/websites-for-trades-and-local-services): services, service area and quote requests for plumbers, detailers, cleaners and other local services
- [How much does a website cost in South Africa?](https://digitalpantry.co.za/website-cost-south-africa): 2026 price ranges with sources, what changes the price, yearly costs
